about_the_game:
Inflafrog is an Endless Arcade Platformer inspired by old retro games, in this game you're a frog going through rooms filled with obstacles while engaging in many risk and reward mechanics to gain as much Score as possible.

EXPLORE THE FOREST

Make your way through randonly assembled rooms filled with all kinds of obstacles, such as urchins, mushrooms, cats and even jellyfishes! Accumulate points after reaching the end of a room to eventually multiply into great ammounts of score! Depending on your chosen items and mightyness. Make it through enough rooms to even visit alternate areas, with their own exclusive obstacles!

  • Easy to pick up: The game is designed around you quickly starting a run whenever you feel like it!

  • High replayability: With it's randonly assembled layouts and increasing difficulty, the game stays fresh even after multiple sessions!

  • Multiple Characters: There are many characters to play with, each one twisting the game in their own unique way!

SPICE UP THE GAMEPLAY

The biggest theme this game is centered on is playing risky to receive massive rewards! It is important to know when to play risky or safe, and how much risk is too much risk. Another important factor is strategically picking items that best suit your current run, in order to keep scoring while staying alive!

  • Multiple Item Choices: Choose between many items capable of permanently improving your stats, such as health, points, multipliers and much more!

  • Special Trinkets: Carry around a specific Trinket to spice up your run! Each Trinket has a unique effect, so every run can have their own twist!

  • Mighty Multiplier: Your main way of scoring big numbers is directly connected to your size. You can increase your scale to increase your multiplier! It will be harder to dodge obstacles that way though, so make sure you know what you're getting yourself into!

GREAT CUSTOMIZATION

You don't have to always look the same while playing Inflafrog, because there are plenty of cosmetics to choose from! You'll first start with a small selection, but as you play though the game you will manage to unlock more and more cosmetics! So make sure to unlock them all!

  • Hats: Give your character a little hat to make them look stylish! The hat will match your scale and stay on you at all times, so make sure to try them all!

  • Palettes: Choose 10 palettes from a large group to be displayed during your runs! Palettes are a group of colors that are used across the entire game, so not a fan of green? Just choose a red palette! There are all kinds of palettes with all kinds of vibes, so make sure to experiment a lot!

  • Music: Along with the visual vibes, you may change the music to whichever fits your mood at the moment! Unlike other cosmetics, you already get to enjoy all of them, so have fun picking your favorite tune!
